description: This file defines the Gmac class, which provides an implementation of GMAC (Galois Message Authentication Code) using AES in ECB mode. It handles cryptographic operations such as updating the internal state with data blocks, finishing the authentication process, and internal finite field multiplication for cryptographic security.

classes.name: Gmac
classes.description: Provides GMAC authentication functionality using AES encryption, with methods for updating data, finalizing the authentication tag, and internal cryptographic operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Gmac object with an AES key, nonce, and optional key size, setting up internal buffers and encrypting initial vectors.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the internal GMAC state with a new data block or blocks, processing them in chunks and managing internal buffers.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the GMAC computation by processing length blocks and producing the authentication tag.

methods.name: bit
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bit from a ByteArray at a given index, used in finite field multiplication.

methods.name: blockMultiply
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication of two 16-byte ByteArrays, ensuring cryptographic security.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Processes any remaining bytes in the buffer to update the GMAC state.
